# Colorado DOR General Fund Net Collections fixture

`general_fund_net_collections_published_2026-09.xlsx` is, byte for byte, the
Google Drive file that the Wayback Machine's 2026-05-05 capture of the
Colorado Department of Revenue's General Fund Collections Reports page links
as "General Fund Collections Report, July 2019 to Date", downloaded on
2026-10-09 (19:41 UTC) for the `co.dor.individual_income_tax.net_collections`
resolver leg. The file name says 2026-09 because its publish-date line does.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Download URL | `https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1Bg4VFz2V2sWbR9Nj9v0ygYOgViFor_CN` |
| File name served | `General Fund Net Collections July 2019 to Date.xlsx` |
| HTTP Last-Modified | Mon, 28 Sep 2026 21:09:16 GMT |
| Bytes | 58,988 |
| SHA-256 | `476df20fbc29e80bb95e4eff369cd3f2d01cb403b422a192b5c969ee1ce05f19` |
| Months (newest first) | August 2026 back to July 2019, 86 columns |
| "Publish date" line | September 2026 |

Its "Total Net Individual Income" row prints 984,764 ($ thousands) for
July 2026, one column behind its newest month. This file alone does not show
when July 2026 first appeared or what was first published for it; its
Last-Modified (2026-09-28) is after the July cell's resolution date
(2026-08-31). See "Colorado DOR net individual income tax collections" in
`docs/anchor-verifications.md`.
